title: Model picker host connection
responsibility: Connects the picker to its MCP host or explicitly enabled standalone preview endpoint.

inputs.name: providerPickerClient.receive
inputs.description: Receives the preview response from `open_model_picker`, or the `structuredContent` of a host result only when it is an object containing `defaultProvider`; other host results are ignored. Preview responses are cast to `PickerSnapshot` without validation.

outputs.name: providerPickerClient
outputs.description: Resolves to a `PickerClient` using standalone preview only when `document.body.dataset.pickerPreview === 'true'` and `window.parent === window`; otherwise it connects an MCP App client. Its `call` accepts a tool name and optional argument record defaulting to `{}`, posts to `/tools` and returns parsed JSON in preview, or calls the host tool and returns `structuredContent`; preview initialization immediately calls `open_model_picker`, qualifying host results reach `receive`, and `close` is a no-op in preview or closes the app.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with `Error('Preview request rejected.')` for a non-OK preview response and with `Error('Selection rejected. Refresh the panel and check the session ID.')` when an MCP tool result sets `isError`; fetch, response JSON parsing, or app connection errors also propagate.
